🇱🇾 EXPLOSIONS REPORTED AT LIBYA’S ZAWIYA REFINERY

Videos from western Libya show explosions and fire at a fuel tank inside the Zawiya refinery, roughly 40 km west of Tripoli. The cause of the latest explosions is not yet clear.

The refinery is strategically important, it has a processing capacity of around 120,000 barrels per day and is linked to the massive Sharara oil field, one of Libya’s principal production centers. 

The incident also comes just two days after the refinery said a drone struck an untreated naphtha storage tank, puncturing it and causing a leak. That earlier incident was contained without injuries or a fire.
